hull_top.orient: split face down (on the bed), crown up; the seam lip hangs 1.5 below the split: print on a 1.5 mm raft-free sacrificial ring or flip crown down with tree supports in the groove only
hull_top.supports: tree supports ON, build plate only: the inner roof of the half shell and under the knuckle and groove floors; the pivot blocks print without (arc outlines)

hull_bottom.supports: tree supports ON, build plate only: the inner roof of the half shell

nose.orient: tip down on the bed (flat Ø22), spigot up
nose.supports: none (tip down, cone walls under 45 deg)

tray.orient: flat underside (z -16: saddle feet, disc bottoms, cradle tubes) on the bed; deck 1 bridges between the saddles and discs, deck 2 between its walls (enable thick bridges)
tray.supports: none (flat underside down: saddle feet, disc bottoms, cradle tubes); deck 1 and deck 2 bridge, enable 'thick bridges'

drill_leg_L.orient: standing on the head's flat rear face (stop face) down, no supports
drill_leg_L.supports: none (flat-bottomed head, D-bore roof bridges 5 mm)

drill_leg_R.orient: standing on the head's flat rear face (stop face) down, no supports
drill_leg_R.supports: none (flat-bottomed head, D-bore roof bridges 5 mm)

drill_leg_L_auger.orient: standing on its base (point up), brim 5 mm
drill_leg_L_auger.supports: none (point up: 45 deg flight load faces, 45 deg roof inside the hub); brim 5 mm, the base is a thin ring

drill_leg_R_auger.orient: standing on its base (point up), brim 5 mm
drill_leg_R_auger.supports: none (point up: 45 deg flight load faces, 45 deg roof inside the hub); brim 5 mm, the base is a thin ring

coupler_L.orient: lying on its D flat (layers along the axle), PPA-CF
coupler_L.supports: PPA-CF (hardened nozzle, dried filament), lying on the D flat, no supports; PLA only as a stopgap

coupler_R.orient: lying on its D flat (layers along the axle), PPA-CF
coupler_R.supports: PPA-CF (hardened nozzle, dried filament), lying on the D flat, no supports; PLA only as a stopgap

righting_leg.orient: upside down (the blade crown on the bed, cheeks up), tree supports under the ends of the pad arch
righting_leg.supports: upside down (the blade crown on the bed, cheeks up); tree supports under the two ends of the pad arch only; 4 walls

leg_coupler_L.orient: lying on its D flat, PPA-CF
leg_coupler_L.supports: PPA-CF, lying on the D flat, no supports

leg_coupler_R.orient: lying on its D flat, PPA-CF
leg_coupler_R.supports: PPA-CF, lying on the D flat, no supports

leg_plug_L.orient: outer face up (a domed button), no supports

leg_plug_R.orient: outer face up (a domed button), no supports
